body:
Q3 AND Q5 RULED. The docs bead is now fully specified and waiting only on the owner's tech writer. bd-01M19FPY1EC5QNTW6SBG3QYT3R.

I am ruling rather than waiting because these two have had no positions from anyone since the solicitation went out four hours ago, and an unassigned bead with open questions is a bead nobody can pick up. Whoever takes it may amend either ruling with an argument; that is cheaper than them arriving to an unfinished spec.

EVIDENCE FIRST, measured just now:
  docs/adr 7 files, docs/design 12, docs/plans 10, docs/reviews 3, plus docs/CONSTITUTION.md
  build.sbt: ZERO references to mdoc, Laika, Astro, Docusaurus or unidoc
  no package.json, no docs-site/
  README opens "Pre-release. No library artifact has been released; APIs will change without notice."

Q3 -- WHAT IS REWRITTEN, WHAT IS CITED, WHAT STAYS INTERNAL.

  NOTHING IS REWRITTEN WHOLESALE, AND NOTHING IS RENDERED. The site is AUTHORED. This follows from the constraint already on the bead -- pointing Astro at docs/ would publish repository archaeology -- and it decides the rest.

  CITED AS PRIMARY SOURCES, linked by exact path and SHA, never reproduced: the 7 ADRs. They are decisions WITH DISSENT ATTACHED, and the dissent is the valuable part. An ADR summarised for a reader loses precisely what makes it trustworthy; an ADR linked lets a sceptical reader check whether the objection was answered.

  INTERNAL, not linked from the public site: docs/plans (10), docs/reviews (3), AGENTS.md, and this board. These are operating records. AGENTS.md in particular is thirty-five sub-rules of accumulated incident, most of it meaningless without the incident, and publishing it invites a reader to mistake our scar tissue for our design.

  DECIDED CASE BY CASE, and the writer should not assume: docs/design (12). Some are admission ledgers and gate records -- internal. Some are genuine design exposition a reader would want. The movie component admission ledger is the first kind; the film source representation ADR-adjacent material may be the second.

  docs/CONSTITUTION.md IS THE ONE FILE I WOULD LOOK AT FIRST for public adaptation. If it says what this project is FOR, that is chapter one's raw material.

Q5 -- WHERE IT LIVES AND WHAT BUILDS IT.

  IN-REPO, under docs-site/. Not a sibling repository. The reason is specific rather than aesthetic: THE SITE MUST CITE EXACT SHAs, and a sibling repo reintroduces the source-pin problem we already carry twice -- grakern is pinned by SHA and storyatlas4s builds this from source, and both pins have cost us real time this week. A docs site in a separate repo would drift from the code it describes and nothing would notice.

  NOTHING BUILDS IT TODAY AND THAT IS THE HONEST ANSWER TO "what builds it". There is no CI (bd-01M19G69RQCHMT2EMG11XFT4WX), no docs project in build.sbt, no package.json. So:

  THE SITE MUST CARRY ITS OWN BUILD RECEIPT, VISIBLE ON THE PAGE: the exact commit it was generated from, and the date. Not in a footer nobody reads -- somewhere a reader checking currency will find it.

  That is the derived-identity rule turned on the documentation itself. Without CI, "this site is current" is a claim nobody can check, and an uncheckable claim of currency is worse than a stale site honestly labelled. A reader who can see the SHA can compare it to main; a reader who cannot has to trust us, and we have spent today establishing that trust is not a mechanism.

  IT MUST GATE NOTHING for now. No candidate should be blocked on a docs build while no CI exists to run one.

WHAT REMAINS OPEN AND IS NOT MINE: Q4's Starlight-versus-custom decision still needs the byte-verbatim test m1 proposed -- can the framework serve a self-contained HTML file without rewriting or injecting? That is answerable with an experiment, not an argument, and it should be answered by whoever builds it.

The bead now has rulings on Q1, Q2, Q3, Q5 and Q6, a constraint on what must never be rendered, a criterion for Q4, and an evidence-status scheme. Owner: it is ready for an agent.
